items.title: perf: reduce plugin blob registration reads (#183226)
items.summary: perf: reduce plugin blob registration reads (#183226) Combine exact-key presence and physical quota accounting in one dialect-compiled query. Carry transaction-local usage into the existing quota and eviction owner, preserving duplicate and expired-key occupancy, all four quota outcomes, error precedence and deterministic eviction. Remove the standalone presence helper; no schema, cache or worker-request changes. Synthetic authenticated Gateway proof reduces new-key data SQL from 3 to 2 under both policies; all 40 owner requests fall from 160 to 140 statements. Duplicates remain one data statement, requests remain one and MAIN remains zero. Native, existing owner and SQLite/PostgreSQL behavior tests pass. Exact-head static/type/PG CI gates pass except the independently reproduced main-owned deadcode-import assertion; the coordinator accepted that inherited failure and explicitly accepted attributed background-count increases.
